topics.title: Allah
topics.short: Allah (الله) is the name in the Quran used for the one and only true God, in accordance with the monotheistic nature of Islam.

topics.title: Day of Resurrection
topics.short: Day of Resurrection (يوم القيامة) is the time in the afterlife when Allah will resurrect and judge humanity.

topics.title: Heart
topics.short: Heart (قلب) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Last Day
topics.short: Last Day (اليوم الآخر) is a name mentioned in the Quran that refers to the Day of resurrection.

topics.title: Earth
topics.short: Earth (أرض) is mentioned in many verses of the Quran as the dwelling of Humanity in the worldly life.

topics.title: Satan
topics.short: Satan (الشيطان) is the devil in Islamic theology, and is a Jinn also known as Iblis.

topics.title: Thunder
topics.short: Thunder (رعد) is one type of Weather phenomena mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Lightning
topics.short: Lightning (برق) is one type of Weather phenomena mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Finger
topics.short: Finger (أصابع) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Ear
topics.short: Ear (أذن) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Rain
topics.short: Rain (مطر) is one type of Weather phenomena mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Mosquito
topics.short: Mosquito (بعوضة) is one of the Insects mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Adam
topics.short: Adam (آدم) is the first man created by God, the first prophet in Islam and father of Cain and Abel.

topics.title: Iblis
topics.short: Iblis (إبليس) is another name for Satan (the devil) who was the Jinn that refused to prostrate before Adam.

topics.title: Paradise
topics.short: Paradise (الجنة) is the place of reward and peace in the afterlife.

topics.title: Tree
topics.short: Tree (شجرة) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Children of Israel
topics.short: Children of Israel (بنى إسرائيل) are mentioned in the Quran when referring to the Israelites. According to Islamic belief, the twelve tribes of Israel are the descendents of Yaqub (Jacob, also known as Israel), who was the son of Isaac.

topics.title: Israel
topics.short: Israel (إسرائيل) is the name of the noble prophet Yaqub (Jacob) that is used when referring to the Israelites, known as the Children of israel in the Quran.

topics.title: Pharaoh
topics.short: Pharaoh (فرعون) is the name of the ruler of Ancient egypt at the time of the story of Musa in the Quran.

topics.title: Musa
topics.short: Musa (موسى) is a noble prophet in Islam, who's name occurs more frequently in the Quran than any other prophet or messenger.

topics.title: Golden Calf
topics.short: Golden Calf (عجل الذهب) is mentioned in the Quran, and refers to the false Idol worshipped by the Israelites during Moses' absence.

topics.title: Cloud
topics.short: Cloud (سحاب) is one type of Weather phenomena mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Quail
topics.short: Quail (سلوى) is one of the types of Bird mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Herb
topics.short: Herb (بقل) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Cucumber
topics.short: Cucumber (قثاء) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Garlic
topics.short: Garlic (ثوم) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Lentil
topics.short: Lentil (عدس) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Onion
topics.short: Onion (بصل) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Judaism
topics.short: Judaism (اليهود) is one of the major religions mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Christianity
topics.short: Christianity (النصارى) is one of the major Religions mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Sabians
topics.short: Sabians (الصابئين) are one of the Religious groups mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Sabbath
topics.short: Sabbath (السبت) is a day of the week that was specified in previous revelations before the Quran.

topics.title: Ape
topics.short: Ape (قرد) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Cow
topics.short: Cow (بقرة) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Color
topics.short: Color (لَون) is a category that refers to the the different colors that are mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Jesus
topics.short: Jesus (عيسى) is the son of Mary and a noble prophet and messenger in Islam.

topics.title: Maryam
topics.short: Maryam (مريم) is the mother of Jesus and son of Imran, and is one of the most highly regarded women in Islam.

topics.title: Jibreel
topics.short: Jibreel (جبريل) is the angel of revelation (also known as Gabriel) who recited the Quran to the prophet Muhammad.

topics.title: Mikaeel
topics.short: Mikaeel (ميكائيل) is the name of an angel mentioned in the Quran (also known as Michael).

topics.title: Solomon
topics.short: Solomon (سليمان) is a noble prophet in Islam who is known as Sulayman in the Quran, and is the son of David.

topics.title: Babylon
topics.short: Babylon (بابل) is mentioned in the Quran. An ancient city in Mesopotamia (c. 3000 BC), Babylon is widely considered to be the cradle of civilization.

topics.title: Harut
topics.short: Harut (هاروت) is the name of an angel mentioned in the Quran, who together with Marut went down to the ancient city of Babylon.

topics.title: Marut
topics.short: Marut (ماروت) is the name of an angel mentioned in the Quran, who together with Harut went down to the ancient city of Babylon.

topics.title: Ibrahim
topics.short: Ibrahim (إبراهيم) is a noble prophet in Islam (also known as Abraham), the son of Azar and the father of Ishmael and Isaac.

topics.title: Kaaba
topics.short: Kaaba (الكعبة) is located in the main mosque in Makkah, Masjid al-haram. Literally "the cube", the kaaba is the current Qiblah - the direction of prayer in Islam.

topics.title: Ishmael
topics.short: Ishmael (إسماعيل) is a noble prophet and messenger in Islam and the first born son of Ibrahim.

topics.title: Islam
topics.short: Islam (الإسلام) is the monotheistic religion based on the Quran and the teachings of the prophet Muhammad.

topics.title: Yaqub
topics.short: Yaqub (يعقوب) is a noble prophet in Islam, the son of Isaac and father of Yusuf (Joseph).

topics.title: Isaac
topics.short: Isaac (إسحاق) is a noble prophet in Islam, the second son of Ibrahim and the father of Yaqub (Jacob).

topics.title: Qiblah
topics.short: Qiblah (قبلة) is the direction of prayer in Islam.

topics.title: Heel
topics.short: Heel (كَعب) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Masjid al-Haram
topics.short: Masjid al-Haram (المسجد الحرام) is the main mosque in Makkah. Surrounding the Kaaba, it is the largest Mosque in the world and the holiest place in Islam.

topics.title: Al-Safa
topics.short: Al-Safa (الصفا) is a small mountain outside Makkah which together with Al-marwah is visited during the Hajj pilgrimage.

topics.title: Al-Marwah
topics.short: Al-Marwah (المروة) is a small mountain outside Makkah which together with Al-safa is visited during the Hajj pilgrimage.

topics.title: Hajj
topics.short: Hajj (حج) is the pilgrimage to Makkah and one of the five pillars of Islam. The pilgrimage occurs during the 12th month of the Islamic calendar.

topics.title: Umra
topics.short: Umra (عمرة) is a pilgrimage to Makkah that may be performed at any time of the year.

topics.title: Ship
topics.short: Ship (سفينة) is one of the man-made Artifacts mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Carrion
topics.short: Carrion (الميتة) is one of the prohibited Foods mentioned in the Quran (the remains of dead animals).

topics.title: Pork
topics.short: Pork (لَحم الخنزير) is one of the prohibited Foods mentioned in the Quran (the flesh of Swine).

topics.title: Ramadan
topics.short: Ramadan (رمضان) is the sacred month of fasting in the Islamic calendar, and the month in which the Night of decree occurs.

topics.title: Quran
topics.short: Quran (القرآن) is the central religious text of Islam, written in Quranic Arabic.

topics.title: Dawn
topics.short: Dawn (فجر) is mentioned in several verses of Quran, usually in the context of worshipping Allah.

topics.title: Mosque
topics.short: Mosque (مسجد) is a category that refers to mosques mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Moon
topics.short: Moon (القمر) is one of the Astronomical objects mentioned in the Quran, usually referred to along with the Sun.

topics.title: Mount Arafat
topics.short: Mount Arafat (عرفات) is small mountain outside Makkah which is visited during the Hajj pilgrimage.

topics.title: Hell
topics.short: Hell (جهنم) is the place of punishment and torment in the afterlife.

topics.title: King
topics.short: King (ملك) is a category that refers to kings who are mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Talut
topics.short: Talut (طالوت) is the name of one of the Kings of the Israelites (also known as Saul) who is mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Ark of the Covenant
topics.short: Ark of the Covenant (تابوت العهد) is mentioned in the Quran to contain artifacts from the household of Musa (Moses) and Harun (Aaron).

topics.title: Harun
topics.short: Harun (هارون) is a noble prophet in Islam the younger brother of Musa.

topics.title: Jalut
topics.short: Jalut (جالوت) is also known as Goliath, and is mentioned in the Quran as being the leader of an army. He was killed by the prophet David (Dawood).

topics.title: David
topics.short: David (داود) is a noble prophet in Islam, who is known as Dawood in the Quran, and is the father of Solomon.

topics.title: Allah's Throne
topics.short: Allah's Throne (العرش) is mentioned in several verses of the Quran, and is also known as al-kursi.

topics.title: Sun
topics.short: Sun (الشمس) is one of the Astronomical objects mentioned in the Quran, usually referred to along with the Moon.

topics.title: Bone
topics.short: Bone (عظم) is mentioned in the Quran most often in reference to Man being resurrected after becoming dust and bones.

topics.title: Bird
topics.short: Bird (طائر) is one of the creations of Allah mentioned by name in the Quran. This category in the ontology includes the general concept of birds, as well as specific types of bird mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Grain
topics.short: Grain (حبة) is one of the Foods mentioned the Quran.

topics.title: Date Palm
topics.short: Date Palm (نخلة) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Grape
topics.short: Grape (عنب) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Torah
topics.short: Torah (التوراة) is the name of the holy book of law given by God to Musa (Moses), according to Islamic belief.

topics.title: Injeel
topics.short: Injeel (الإنجيل) is the name of the holy book revealed by God to Jesus, according to Islamic belief.

topics.title: Eye
topics.short: Eye (عين) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Gold
topics.short: Gold (ذهب) is one of the types of Metal mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Silver
topics.short: Silver (فضة) is one of the types of Metal mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Horse
topics.short: Horse (حصان) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Nuh
topics.short: Nuh (نوح) is a noble prophet in Islam who is mentioned in the Quran to have lived to around 950 years in age, at the time of the great flood.

topics.title: Imran
topics.short: Imran (عمران) is known in the Quran as the father of Maryam (Mary).

topics.title: Zechariah
topics.short: Zechariah (زكريا) is a noble prophet in Islam and father of Yahya (John). Zechariah was also the guardian of Maryam (Mary).

topics.title: Yahya
topics.short: Yahya (يحيى) is a noble prophet in Islam (known in the Bible as John the Baptist) and is the son of Zechariah.

topics.title: Pen
topics.short: Pen (قلم) is mentioned in several verses of the Quran.

topics.title: Messiah
topics.short: Messiah (المسيح) is a name used in the Quran for Jesus.

topics.title: Clay
topics.short: Clay (صلصال) is the Substance that Man was originally created from, according to the Quran and Islamic belief.

topics.title: Leprosy
topics.short: Leprosy (الأبرص) is one of the diseases mentioned in the Quran in the context of the miracles of the noble prophet Jesus, son of Mary.

topics.title: Tongue
topics.short: Tongue (لسان) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Bakkah
topics.short: Bakkah (بكة) is another name for the holy city of Makkah (Mecca).

topics.title: Badr
topics.short: Badr (بدر) is the name of a city in Arabia mentioned in the Quran, at which an early Islamic battle took place.

topics.title: Muhammad
topics.short: Muhammad (محمد) is the name of the last prophet and messenger of Allah.

topics.title: Ayyub
topics.short: Ayyub (أيوب) is a noble prophet and messenger in Islam (also known as Job) who is mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Yunus
topics.short: Yunus (يونس) is a noble prophet in Islam whose story with the fish is mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Zabur
topics.short: Zabur (زبور) is the name of the holy book revealed by God to David (the Book of Psalms), according to Islamic belief.

topics.title: Arrow
topics.short: Arrow (سهم) is mentioned in the Quran in the context of divining arrows, which are prohibited according to Islamic law.

topics.title: Abel
topics.short: Abel (هابيل) is the brother of Cain and son of Adam. The story of Cain and Abel is mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Cain
topics.short: Cain (قابيل) is the brother of Abel and son of Adam. The story of Cain and Abel is mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Crow
topics.short: Crow (غراب) is one of the types of Bird mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Al-Jahiliyah
topics.short: Al-Jahiliyah (الجاهلية) is the pre-Islamic time of ignorance.

topics.title: Pig
topics.short: Pig (خنزير) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Wine
topics.short: Wine (خمر) is one of the prohibited Foods mentioned in the Quran, along with other intoxicants.

topics.title: Ladder
topics.short: Ladder (سلم) is mentioned in the Quran, and is also translated into English as "stairway".

topics.title: Wing
topics.short: Wing (جناح) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Key
topics.short: Key (مفتاح) is mentioned in several verses of the Quran.

topics.title: Leaf
topics.short: Leaf (ورقة) is one of the parts of Plants mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Azar
topics.short: Azar (آزر) is mentioned in the Quran as the father of Ibrahim (Abraham).

topics.title: Idol
topics.short: Idol (الأصنام) is a category which refers to idols and other false objects of worship, that are mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Star
topics.short: Star (نجم) is one of the Astronomical objects mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Yusuf
topics.short: Yusuf (يوسف) is a noble prophet in Islam and one of the sons of the prophet Yaqub (Jacob).

topics.title: Elijah
topics.short: Elijah (إلياس) is a noble prophet in Islam whose name is mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Elisha
topics.short: Elisha (اليسع) is a noble prophet in Islam whose name is mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Lut
topics.short: Lut (لوط) is a noble prophet in Islam who was sent by God to warn his people to turn away from evil acts.

topics.title: Green
topics.short: Green (أخضر) is one of the Colors mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Olive
topics.short: Olive (زيتون) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Pomegranate
topics.short: Pomegranate (رمان) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Jinn
topics.short: Jinn (الجن) is a category in the ontology which refers to the creations of Allah mentioned in the Quran known as the jinn.

topics.title: Sheep
topics.short: Sheep (غنم) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Goat
topics.short: Goat (ماعز) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Camel
topics.short: Camel (جمل) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Intestine
topics.short: Intestine (أمعاء) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Children of Adam
topics.short: Children of Adam (بنى آدم) is an alternative name mentioned in the Quran that refers to Humanity, the descendents of Adam.

topics.title: Noah's Ark
topics.short: Noah's Ark (سفينة نوح) is mentioned in the Quran as a sign of Allah.

topics.title: Aad
topics.short: Aad (عاد) are a historic people mentioned in the Quran who were sent the prophet Hud.

topics.title: Hud
topics.short: Hud (هود) is a noble prophet in Islam (also known as Eber) who was sent to the people of Aad.

topics.title: Thamud
topics.short: Thamud (ثمود) is the name of a people mentioned in the Quran who carved stone houses out of mountains in ancient Arabia. They were sent the prophet Salih.

topics.title: Salih
topics.short: Salih (صالح) is a noble prophet in Islam who was sent to the people of Thamud.

topics.title: Madyan
topics.short: Madyan (مدين) is the name of a people mentioned in the Quran who were sent the prophet Shuayb.

topics.title: Shuayb
topics.short: Shuayb (شعيب) is a noble prophet in Islam who is considered by many to be synonymous with the Biblical figure of Jethro.

topics.title: Snake
topics.short: Snake (حية) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Locust
topics.short: Locust (جرادة) is one of the Insects mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Louse
topics.short: Louse (القمل) is one of the Insects mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Frog
topics.short: Frog (ضفدع) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Fish
topics.short: Fish (حوت) are one of the creations of Allah mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Dog
topics.short: Dog (كلب) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Hunayn
topics.short: Hunayn (حنين) is the name of a city in Arabia mentioned in the Quran, at which an early Islamic battle took place.

topics.title: Uzair
topics.short: Uzair (عزير) is the name of a historic person mentioned in the Quran (also known as Ezra), who according to Islamic belief used to be falsely called "the son of God".

topics.title: Forehead
topics.short: Forehead (جبهة) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Garden of Eden
topics.short: Garden of Eden (جنات عدن) is the name of a place of everlasting bliss in afterlife.

topics.title: Bedouin
topics.short: Bedouin (أعراب) are mentioned several times in the Quran.

topics.title: Ansar
topics.short: Ansar (أنصار) are mentioned in the Quran, and were the citizens of Medinah that helped the prophet Muhammad during the migration from Makkah (literally, "the helpers").

topics.title: Medinah
topics.short: Medinah (المدينة المنورة) is a holy city in Islam (also known as Yathrib) and is located in the Hijaz region of Arabia.

topics.title: Boat
topics.short: Boat (سفينة) is one of the man-made Artifacts mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Egypt
topics.short: Egypt (مصر) is a land mentioned in the Quran that refers to what is known today as Ancient Egypt.

topics.title: Al-Judi
topics.short: Al-Judi (الجودي) is the mountain on which Noah's ark came to rest after the great flood.

topics.title: Forelock
topics.short: Forelock (ناصية) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Arabic
topics.short: Arabic (العربية) is mentioned by Allah to be the Language in which the Quran was revealed, and is the language of the Arabs.

topics.title: Wolf
topics.short: Wolf (ذئب) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Coin
topics.short: Coin (دَراهِم) is one of the man-made Artifacts mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Knife
topics.short: Knife (سكينة) is mentioned in the Quran in the story of the noble prophet Yusuf (Joseph).

topics.title: Bread
topics.short: Bread (خبز) is one of the Foods mentioned the Quran.

topics.title: Dust
topics.short: Dust (تراب) is one of the Physical substances mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Iron
topics.short: Iron (حديد) is one of the types of Metal mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Language
topics.short: Language (لغة) is a category that refers to the languages mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Constellation
topics.short: Constellation (البروج) is one of the Astronomical objects mentioned in the Quran, although the Arabic term is also translated into English as "great stars".

topics.title: Companions of the Wood
topics.short: Companions of the Wood (أصحاب الأيكة) is a name used in the Quran to refer to a group of people from the nation of Shuayb.

topics.title: People of al-Hijr
topics.short: People of al-Hijr (أصحاب الحجر) are a group of people who are mentioned in the Quran, as an alternative name for the people of Thamud.

topics.title: Mule
topics.short: Mule (بغل) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Milk
topics.short: Milk (لبن) is one of the Foods mentioned the Quran as a sign of creation.

topics.title: Bee
topics.short: Bee (نحلة) is one of the Insects mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Honey
topics.short: Honey (عسل) is one of the Foods mentioned the Quran as a sign of creation.

topics.title: Masjid al-Aqsa
topics.short: Masjid al-Aqsa (المسجد الأقصى) is a sacred mosque in Jerusalem, considered to be the third holiest place in Islam.

topics.title: Soil
topics.short: Soil (ثرى) is one of the Physical substances mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Companions of the Cave
topics.short: Companions of the Cave (أصحاب الكهف) are a group of people whose story is recounted in the chapter of the Quran named "The Cave".

topics.title: Brass
topics.short: Brass (مهل) is one of the types of Metal mentioned in the Quran, although the Arabic term used is also translated into English as "copper" or "oil".

topics.title: Silk
topics.short: Silk (حرير) is one of the precious Materials mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Dhul Qarnayn
topics.short: Dhul Qarnayn (ذو القرنين) is righteous ruler mentioned in the Quran who constructed a wall to hold Gog and magog. His story is recounted in the chapter of the Quran named "The Cave".

topics.title: Gog and Magog
topics.short: Gog and Magog (يأجوج ومأجوج) are a group of people mentioned in the Quran who are kept behind a great wall.

topics.title: Firdous
topics.short: Firdous (الفردوس) is one of the names of Paradise mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Ink
topics.short: Ink (حبر) is mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Idris
topics.short: Idris (إدريس) is a noble prophet in Islam (also known as Enoch) whose name is mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Samiri
topics.short: Samiri (السامرى) is mentioned in the Quran as the one who turned against Musa (Moses) and misled people to worship the Golden calf.

topics.title: Alaq
topics.short: Alaq (علق) is usually translated into English as a clinging substance or clot, and refers to an early stage in the development of the Embryo in the womb.

topics.title: Magians
topics.short: Magians (المجوس) are one of the Religious groups mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Pearl
topics.short: Pearl (لؤلؤ) is one of the precious Materials mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Monastery
topics.short: Monastery (صوامع) is one of the Places of worhsip mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Church

topics.title: Synagogue

topics.title: Oil

topics.title: Lip

topics.title: Lamp
topics.short: Lamp (لمبة) is mentioned in several verses of the Quran.

topics.title: Glass
topics.short: Glass (زجاج) is one of the Materials mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Salt
topics.short: Salt (ملح) is mentioned in the Quran as one of the signs of creation, in the context of the division of the seas into freshwater and saltwater.

topics.title: Ant
topics.short: Ant (نمل) is one of the Insects mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Hoopoe
topics.short: Hoopoe (هدهد) is one of the types of Bird mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Sheba
topics.short: Sheba (سبأ) is an ancient land mentioned in the Quran that was ruled over by Balqis, the Queen of Sheba.

topics.title: Beast of the Earth
topics.short: Beast of the Earth (دابة الارض) is mentioned in Quran. The nature of the beast is further explained in the hadith of the prophet Muhammad.

topics.title: Haman
topics.short: Haman (هامان) is the name of the chief minister of the Pharaoh at the time of Musa (Moses).

topics.title: Qarun
topics.short: Qarun (قارون) is the name of an Israelite mentioned in the Quran who turned against Musa (Moses).

topics.title: Spider
topics.short: Spider (عنكبوت) is one of the Insects mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Romans
topics.short: Romans (الروم) are an ancient people who are mentioned in Quran, in verse (30:2). A chapter of the Quran is also named after the Romans.

topics.title: Luqman
topics.short: Luqman (لقمان) is the name of righteous and wise man mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Azrael
topics.short: Azrael (عزرائيل) is the name of the Angel of death, according to general Islamic belief, although the name Azrael is not mentioned explicitly in the Quran.

topics.title: Yathrib
topics.short: Yathrib (يثرب) is another name for the holy city of Medinah.

topics.title: Desert
topics.short: Desert (صحراء) is one of the Geographical locations mentioned the Quran.

topics.title: Zayd
topics.short: Zayd (زيد) is mentioned by name in the Quran and was the adopted son of the prophet Muhammad.

topics.title: Coat of Mail
topics.short: Coat of Mail (سابغات) is mentioned in the Quran as having been constructed by the prophet Dawood (David) from Iron, to use as armour.

topics.title: Lote Tree
topics.short: Lote Tree (السدرة) is a Location in the afterlife that is mentioned in the Quran, and is usually considered to be part of Paradise.

topics.title: Zaqqum
topics.short: Zaqqum (زقوم) is the name of a Tree, that according to Islamic belief grows in Jahannam (Hell).

topics.title: Baal
topics.short: Baal (بعل) is the name of a false deity mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Dhul Kifl
topics.short: Dhul Kifl (ذو الكفل) is a righteous man who some Muslims also consider to be a noble prophet, altough this is not mentioned explictly in the Quran.

topics.title: Horizon
topics.short: Horizon (أفق) is one of the Geographical locations mentioned the Quran.

topics.title: Malik
topics.short: Malik (مالك) is the name of an angel mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Tubba
topics.short: Tubba (تبع) are an ancient people who are mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Al-Ahqaf
topics.short: Al-Ahqaf (الأحقاف) is a historic region mentioned in the Quran that refers to the curved sand dunes in the southern part of the Arabian peninsula.

topics.title: Makkah
topics.short: Makkah (مكة) is the holiest city in Islam (also known as Mecca) and is located in the Hijaz region of Arabia.

topics.title: Companions of the Rass
topics.short: Companions of the Rass (أصحاب الرس) are a group of people who are mentioned in the Quran (also known as the companions of the well).

topics.title: Meat

topics.title: Al-Uzza

topics.title: Manat
topics.short: Manat (مناة) is the name of a false pre-Islamic goddess mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Embryo
topics.short: Embryo (أجنة) is one of the stages of Human development mentioned in the Quran, although the Arabic term used is also translated into English as "fetus".

topics.title: Sirius
topics.short: Sirius (الشِّعرى) is one of the Astronomical objects mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Saqar
topics.short: Saqar (سقر) is one of the names of Hell (Jahannam) mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Coral

topics.title: Ruby

topics.title: Ahmad
topics.short: Ahmad (أحمد) is one of the names of the noble prophet and messenger Muhammad.

topics.title: Friday
topics.short: Friday (الجمعة) is the day of the week in which the Jumu'ah prayer is performed (the Friday prayer).

topics.title: Snout
topics.short: Snout (خرطوم) is one of the Parts of the body mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Ladha
topics.short: Ladha (لظى) is one of the names of Hell (Jahannam) mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Wadd
topics.short: Wadd (واد) is the name of a false deity mentioned in the Quran, who was worshipped at the time of the prophet Nuh (Noah).

topics.title: Suwa
topics.short: Suwa (سواع) is the name of a false deity mentioned in the Quran, who was worshipped at the time of the prophet Nuh (Noah).

topics.title: Yaghuth
topics.short: Yaghuth (يغوث) is the name of a false deity mentioned in the Quran, who was worshipped at the time of the prophet Nuh (Noah).

topics.title: Yauq
topics.short: Yauq (يعوق) is the name of a false deity mentioned in the Quran, who was worshipped at the time of the prophet Nuh (Noah).

topics.title: Nasr
topics.short: Nasr (نسر) is the name of a false deity mentioned in the Quran, who was worshipped at the time of the prophet Nuh (Noah).

topics.title: Lion
topics.short: Lion (أسد) is one of the Animals mentioned by name in the Quran.

topics.title: Ginger
topics.short: Ginger (زنجبيل) is one of the types of Plant mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Salsabil
topics.short: Salsabil (سلسبيل) is the name of a fountain or spring, that the Quran mentions as being located in Paradise.

topics.title: Sijjeen
topics.short: Sijjeen (سجين) is a name used to refer to both a record of evil deeds, as well as part of Jahannam (Hell).

topics.title: Companions of the Pit

topics.title: Fig

topics.title: Night of Decree
topics.short: Night of Decree (ليلة القدر) is the night in the month of Ramadan in which the Quran was revealed to the prophet Muhammad (also known as the Night of Power).

topics.title: Companions of the Elephant
topics.short: Companions of the Elephant (أصحاب الفيل) are a group of people whose story is recounted in the chapter of the Quran named "The Elephant".

topics.title: Quraysh
topics.short: Quraysh (قريش) is the name of the tribe to which the prophet Muhammad belonged.

topics.title: Organic Object

topics.short: Biological Organism is a category that refers to biological organisms that are mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Insect

topics.title: Plant

topics.short: Disease is a category that refers to diseases mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Food
topics.short: Food is a category that refers to foods mentioned in the Quran, and includes both lawful foods as well as foods that are prohibited according to Islamic law.

topics.title: Sentient Creation
topics.short: Sentient Creation is a category which refers to the Angels, Jinn, Humanity and other sentient creations mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Angel
topics.short: Angel (الملائكة) is a category in the ontology which refers to the creations of Allah mentioned in the Quran known as angels. According to Islamic belief, the angels were created from light in an analogous way to how the Jinn were created from fire, and Man from Clay.

topics.title: Human
topics.short: Human is a category in the ontology which refers to individual human beings or groups of people mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Historic People
topics.short: Historic People is a category that refers to ancient nations, tribes and other groups of historic people mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Historic Person
topics.short: Historic Person is a category in the ontology which refers to individual historic people mentioned by name in the Quran, or who are well-known in Islam.

topics.title: Messenger
topics.short: Messenger is a category that refers to the messengers of Allah mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Prophet
topics.short: Prophet is a category that refers to the prophets of Allah mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Location

topics.title: Afterlife Location

topics.title: City

topics.title: Historic Land

topics.title: Mountain

topics.title: Physical Attribute
topics.short: Physical Attribute is a category that refers to the attributes of physical objects.

topics.title: Physical Substance
topics.short: Physical Substance is a category that refers to physical substances mentioned in the Quran.

topics.title: Metal

topics.title: Mineral

topics.short: ۩ Doctrine (e.g acts of worship, human interactions, family relations, and business transactions), which focuses mainly on a Muslim’s relationship with Allah, other people, and the rest of Allah’s creation.

topics.title: Stories
topics.short: ⌛ Stories(e.g., the story of Moses, Noah, and Ṣâliḥ), which served two purposes: to reassure the Prophet’s heart, as he was met with rejection in Mecca, and as cautionary tales for the pagans (see <reference chapter="11" verses="120-123">11:120-123</reference>). Other stories (e.g., Joseph and Job) focus on moral lessons.

topics.title: The Unseen
topics.short: ☼ The Unseen (e.g the belief in Allah and His qualities, as well as angels, resurrection, judgment, etc.), which reaffirms one’s faith in the divine through one’s heart, not eyes.
